name: software-project
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Standard enterprise software delivery lifecycle pipeline: Contract Lock -> Parallel Vertical Execution -> Shift-Left Deterministic Gate -> QA/Security Sign-off -> DevOps Release.

phases.name: Contract Lock & Architecture Scaffolding
phases.instructions: Extract existing skeletons if any via node .agents/bin/code-query.mjs skeleton. Produce executable contracts.ts with Zod schemas and TypeScript interfaces. Scaffold database models and .env.example.

phases.name: Database Modeling & Reversible Migrations
phases.instructions: Generate reversible database migrations (UP/DOWN) and deterministic seed data adhering to contracts.ts.

phases.name: Parallel Vertical Slice Execution
phases.instructions: Execute complete vertical slices in parallel against locked contracts.ts. Each engineer runs node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally before handoff.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Execute node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. If fail, run orchestra-state.mjs map-failures and dispatch back to owning vertical engineers (capped at 3 retries). Advance only on PASS.

phases.name: QA, Security & E2E Verification
phases.instructions: Triggered ONLY after quality-gate.mjs passes. Run E2E journeys, security scan, and review git diff against user requirements.

phases.name: DevOps Packaging & Production Release
phases.instructions: Containerize with hardened multi-stage Dockerfile, wire health/ready probes, generate release changelog and tag version.
